summary: Iteration 2 — slot RTP recalibration (backend) + Auditor's Ledger admin redesign + slot UX (anticipation/near-miss) + 3D regression. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass against /api/points/1/slots — total_mult now small fractional (0..3.76 across 30 fruits-theme spins), payout = int(round(bet*mult)), 19/30 zero-payout spins (RTP path is realistic, not the old 9x-15x absurd values), JSON shape preserved (16 expected keys present), egypt+space themes smoke-pass. Admin (/, no auth): paper-white background rgb(239,239,233) = #EFEFE9 confirmed, JetBrains Mono primary font, 29 Lucide SVG icons rendered (no emojis in sidebar nav-icons; all 4 icons are <svg>), Finnish nav OPERAATIOT/ASIAKASREKISTERI/PÖYTÄVERKKO / TXH/JÄRJESTELMÄ render uppercase with sharp corners. Dashboard h1 'Operaatiot//Pääte' Chivo-stack font, 4 stat cards in [data-testid=dash-stats] (€0.00 values + count). Players view shows TestPelaaja row with GOLD badge, €0.00 saldo, points=943615, 'Uusi asiakas' add btn opens modal 'Lisää pelaaja'. Poker view: PÖYTÄVERKKO//TXH header, felt black rgb(10,10,10), 6 stage pills (Odottaa active in solid black + Pre-Flop/Flop/Turn/River/Showdown), 'Uusi peli' btn visible, hand-log-panel renders. Settings: JÄRJESTELMÄ header, all 4 inputs (s-ppu/s-min/s-max/s-exp) present with 1px solid #0a0a0a borders, JetBrains Mono font, save btn solid black bg + white text. Customer /asiakas slots (TestPelaaja/test123): @keyframes nearMissFlash, findNearMissCell helper, .anticipation class, CLIENT_PAYLINES all present in source. 20 live spins via [data-testid=slots-spin-btn] avg 2463ms (2015-3542ms range) — within ~3s normal-mode spec. Anticipation class OBSERVED in DOM during at least one spin (RNG path works). Near-miss class NOT observed in 20 spins (CSS + JS helper wired but did not trigger in sample). 3D regression: BJ canvas 426x318 + Baccarat canvas 426x318 still render fine. No JS errors, no pageerrors.

issues: Modal title is 'Lisää pelaaja' (Add player) instead of spec text 'Lisää asiakas' (Add customer). Cosmetic Finnish copy mismatch — the rest of the admin uses 'asiakas/asiakasrekisteri' terminology, so the modal should also say 'Lisää asiakas' for consistency.

action_items: Optional copy fix: change Add-player modal title from 'Lisää pelaaja' to 'Lisää asiakas' to match the rest of the admin's 'asiakas' terminology and the original spec.

Optional: 30-spin sample RTP came in at 276% (high variance with n=30). Main agent's 200k Monte Carlo of 84-86% is the source of truth; no action needed unless extended live sampling shows persistent skew.

Optional: near-miss class did not visually fire in 20 sample spins. CSS keyframe + JS helper are wired, so this is RNG-driven; consider lowering near-miss threshold (e.g. 3-of-5 instead of 4-of-5 along payline) if you want it to be visibly perceptible to players in normal sessions.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/templates/index.html is large (~3000+ lines mixing CSS, HTML, JS — admin SPA). Consider splitting CSS to /static/admin.css and JS to /static/admin.js for maintainability.

/app/templates/customer.html similarly monolithic (already noted iteration 1). Slot client logic + anticipation timing now adds ~80 more lines of inline JS; would benefit from extraction to /static/slots.js.

Slot RTP calibrations duplicated between /app/app.py (lines 1099-1175) and /app/api/index.py (lines 301-377). Drift risk — extract SLOT_THEMES + payout tables to a shared module imported by both Flask app variants.

Spec said admin requires 'no auth' — confirmed in this run (GET / returned 200 with full content). For a production casino-back-office this is a serious access control gap; recommend gating /admin behind SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD-style basic auth before any deployment.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% (all admin redesign + slot UX + 3D regression flows pass; only non-blocking finding is one Finnish copy nit on Add-player modal title)

test_credentials: Customer: TestPelaaja / test123 at /asiakas (player ID 1, points 943615 after the 20 test spins). Admin: no auth at /.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing TestPelaaja. Backend test ran 30 fruits + 1 egypt + 1 space spin = 32 slot transactions @ bet=100. UI ran 20 fruits spins. Net points balance changed but no players/users created/deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin SPA lives at GET / (NOT /admin which 404s). Active view detection in JS: each <section class='view'> has id 'view-dashboard|view-players|view-poker|view-settings'; only one has display!=none at a time. Add-player modal uses .modal-overlay.open + .modal-box + .modal-head selectors (no .modal.show). Stage pills selector: .stage-pill (active gets .active class, inverted black). Customer slots: data-testid='slots-spin-btn' is the canonical selector (worked first try); spin durations are 2.0-3.5s in normal mode — wait at least 3.5s before asserting result. Anticipation .anticipation class was observed in 1 of 20 spins (works but rare). Near-miss .near-miss did not appear in 20 spins (RNG-driven, not a bug). Backend duplicates RTP code in /app/app.py AND /app/api/index.py — when verifying any slot fix, edit both.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical bugs found. RTP calibration math verified: with 30 spins the payout=int(round(bet*total_mult)) formula matches every response, and total_mult dropped from old 75-1000 range to 0..3.76. Admin redesign Swiss-Modernist styling (#EFEFE9 paper, JetBrains Mono, Lucide SVGs, sharp 1px borders, no shadows) renders correctly across all 4 views. Anticipation flow is wired and observable (CSS class actually applied to non-stopped reels mid-spin); near-miss flow is wired in source but RNG-rare in 20 spins.
